# The engine's feed-idempotency-v1 keyed route set (U-173, P26 E2): bank feed categorize, approve and
# match (Idempotency-Key optional) and the review decisions duplicate and review-again (key required,
# 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED), x-idempotency: true in its openapi.json. Append-only for this capability
# name: KeySet::FeedV1 in operations.rs, keyed only while the engine advertises feed-idempotency-v1.
POST /api/v1/banking/feed/{id}/approve
POST /api/v1/banking/feed/{id}/duplicate
POST /api/v1/banking/feed/{id}/review-again
PUT /api/v1/banking/feed/{id}/categorize
PUT /api/v1/banking/feed/{id}/match
